scoring_rule: Each criterion is a binary scope commitment. An area score is 100 * completed criterion weight / total criterion weight. The repository score is the same calculation across all criteria, not an average of rounded area scores. A criterion is complete only when its locked scope is met and its stated evidence is current; missing, partial, stale, or substituted evidence scores zero. Do not mark a criterion complete by narrowing or replacing its locked scope.

criteria.scope: Shipped lm / lm_df / lmer / lmer_weighted / predict surface for the documented LMM workflows (REML/ML, nested and crossed RE, weights).
Integration and unit tests exercise the shipped LMM API, including predict, weights, and common RE layouts.
Golden / comparison fixtures lock LMM coefficients, theta, and sigma2 on named datasets (sleepstudy, dyestuff, pastes, penicillin).
A dated full-suite fair-harness artifact shows every tier-A LMM cold_fit (and measured fit_prepared) below the strict 1.0× Julia gate. LMM math/optimizer must not have changed since that artifact.
Shipped glmer / glmer_weighted with binomial, Poisson, Gaussian, and gamma families, canonical plus selectable non-canonical links, Laplace default and AGQ-in-θ when the grid fits.
Tests cover Laplace and AGQ paths, weights, and the shipped families/links.
Golden fixtures lock coefficients and variance parameters for canonical plus named non-canonical links (probit, cloglog); AIC/BIC identity with R is a documented non-goal.
Gamma log-link Dyestuff locks mean, residual phi, and RE theta against lme4 rather than collapsing theta to the bound.

areas.name: Rust crate: formula and model matrices

criteria.scope: Wilkinson parser and model-matrix builder cover intercept, nested/crossed RE, two-way * / :, log/sqrt/exp, I() arithmetic, and offset() including transformed offsets.
Parser and design-matrix behavior is locked by unit and stress tests.

poly() (orthogonal and raw), ns() with df-based knots, and y ~ . expansion materialize into the design matrix and are reused by predict. ns(knots=) and multivariate cbind() remain documented non-goals.
Wald and profile CIs (including parms=), simulate, boot_lmer / boot_glmer, robust SE, Satterthwaite, and Kenward–Roger are shipped.
Targeted tests cover profile CIs, bootstrap, and the shipped ddf helpers.
Fixed-effect profile CIs and Kenward–Roger dfs match R on the covered LMM fixtures.
Variance-component profile (and bootstrap percentile) intervals have lme4 goldens beyond a single intercept-only sleepstudy fit: at least random-slopes LMM VC and a GLMM VC fixture, not smoke-only.
criteria.gap: Sleepstudy intercept-only ML locks .sig01/.sigma. Random-slopes VC is ungolden. GLMM VC is a cbpp smoke test with no R fixture. nlmer profile CIs are unsupported.

areas.name: Rust crate: ANOVA and model comparison

criteria.scope: Type I/II/III ANOVA, nested LRT, linear_hypothesis, and user contrast matrices are shipped.
Tests cover typed ANOVA, contrasts, and joint multi-DoF categorical rows.
Golden fixtures lock Type I–III and named contrast/KR cases against R on covered LMM models.

Tukey/Dunnett glht (multcomp::mcp pairwise family) and LMM reference-grid emmeans / emmeans_pairs with an R golden. Not a full multcomp/emmeans replacement (no mvtnorm single-step, compact letters, offsets, or GLMM response-scale marginalization).
Python mirrors the Rust formula API: lm, lmer, glmer, nlmer, prepare/fit_prepared, CV, boot, profile CIs, ANOVA, glht, emmeans.
pytest covers the shipped Python surface, including golden parity for named cases.
lme_python.pyi stubs and PYTHON_GUIDE document the shipped functions and result types.
Numeric lm(y, x) / lm_matrix is exposed from Python, matching Rust lm(y, x).
JSON/CSV fixtures and comparison scripts exist for the named LMM, GLMM, and nlmer datasets.
Rust golden-parity tests lock the manifest cases.
Comparisons document Rust/R/Python/Julia coverage for the datasets in COMPARISONS.md.
A breadth-first lme4 fit matrix covers Wilkinson/RE edges beyond the main golden manifest, with coefficient-level agreement where bases are comparable, and at least one GLMM formula edge.
criteria.gap: Eight LMM cases exist. ns() locks fitted values because the spline basis is not identical to splines::ns. There is no GLMM/nlmer formula edge, and cbind() / ns(knots=) are absent.

criteria.scope: Criterion benches cover math/fit microbenchmarks used as a regression guard.
The fair Rust vs MixedModels.jl harness times cold_fit and optional prepare/fit_prepared for the tier-A catalog.
BENCHMARKS.md and BENCHMARK_COVERAGE.md describe tiers, cases, and which results may be used for completion.
A comparable external timing artifact covers nlmer, Kenward–Roger (Rust and R), Satterthwaite, and Python FFI with a clock fine enough to compare implementations.
criteria.gap: The 2026-08-14 JSON is a smoke: R Kenward–Roger is skipped (pbkrtest missing), R system.time is ~10ms resolution, and the run is 1 warmup / 5 repeats on one host. That is not comparable timing evidence.

Hosted CI on pull requests and v* tags runs the locked matrix, all-targets check, doctests, multi-OS, and isolated-wheel tests.
SHA-pinned Actions, Dependabot, weekly audit, and fuzz-smoke workflows exist.
GitHub Actions validation runs automatically on pull requests, not only on tags and workflow_dispatch.
GUIDE.md and PYTHON_GUIDE.md cover the shipped modeling, inference, and repeated-fit APIs, including nlmer.
README, CONTRIBUTING, RELEASING, BENCHMARKS, OPTIMIZATION, and COMPARISONS document install, limits, and operations.
USABILITY.md and README limitations are current for the crate version (pre-1.0 identity, workflow traffic lights, not a drop-in lme4 replacement).
task docs:check verifies tracked Markdown links, Rust examples/doctests, and generated API docs in pull-request/tag CI.
Cargo [[example]] entries cover the comparison datasets and documented workflows.
python/examples includes portable scripts plus the verification mini-project.
R/Julia and plotting demos exist as optional environment-dependent extensions.
task consumer:smoke runs the Rust sleepstudy workflow and every portable Python example in a clean-wheel environment; CI repeats the wheel examples on Linux, Windows, and macOS.
Standalone probes exist for native-parser AST dump, a 1-D θ grid vs MLE, and MCP adjustment ordering.

A crate-integrated exploration surface (library APIs or a maintained corpus beyond three Cargo examples) is tested in CI. Scoring both this criterion and explorations-standalone requires more than the same three examples.
criteria.gap: The original ast_explorations corpus was removed with fiasto. Three Cargo examples plus tests/test_explorations.rs restore standalone probes; they do not add a separate crate-integrated surface. This row is auxiliary.

criteria.scope: nlmer / nlmer_with_options / nlmer_with_mean ship with the documented SS* catalog, optional bounds, and Laplace or AGQ-in-θ.
Dedicated nlmer test modules cover Orange, self-start, bounds, AGQ, custom means, and the built-in SS* functions.
Golden / comparison fixtures lock named SS* fits (including SSlogis Orange and additional means in the golden manifest).
More than one grouping factor in the random part (crossed or multiple | terms), matching the LMM formula surface.
criteria.gap: NlmerFormula stores a single re_group. Random effects are additive on named nonlinear parameters for one grouping factor only.

criteria.scope: Profile CIs for nonlinear parameters / RE SDs and the LMM post-fit helpers that are documented as applying to nlmer fits.
criteria.gap: confint_profile_vc rejects nlmer fits. emmeans is LMM/linear-only. Post-fit NLMM inference is Wald/summary plus generic LmeFit helpers, not an nlmer-specific profile/emmeans path.
